words.chinese: 鼓勵；促使；鼓舞

words.chinese: 平等；均等，指在機會、待遇等方面沒有差異。

words.engDef: people from Europe

words.chinese: 歐洲人；居住在歐洲的人。

words.engDef: activities done to practise a skill or keep fit
words.example: The company offers various training exercises to improve employee performance.
words.chinese: 練習；鍛鍊（通常指為了提升技能或體能的活動）

words.engDef: doing physical activity, or making use of a right
words.example: The company encourages employees to exercise regularly to maintain good health.
words.chinese: 鍛鍊；從事體能活動（通常為提升健康或體能）

words.engDef: a person living and working outside their own country
words.example: The company offers relocation packages for expatriates assigned to overseas offices.
words.chinese: 外派員工；移居海外工作者

words.chinese: 期待的；預期的；有期望的

words.engDef: beliefs about what will or should happen
words.example: The company has high expectations for all new employees to contribute to the team's success.
words.chinese: 期望；預期，尤其指基於經驗或標準而產生的期望。

words.engDef: having done something many times before

words.chinese: 富經驗的；在某領域擁有豐富經驗的

words.engDef: a member of staff who has worked in the role for a long time
words.example: We are looking for an experienced employee to manage the new project.
words.chinese: 經驗豐富的員工，通常指在特定職位或領域擁有多年工作經驗的員工。

words.engDef: money paid in addition to normal wages
words.example: Employees are eligible for extra pay if they work overtime.
words.chinese: 額外薪酬；加班費

words.engDef: groups of people related to each other

words.example: All employees are required to undergo first aid training as part of the company's safety protocol.
words.chinese: 急救處理；緊急醫療照護

words.engDef: the state of being healthy and physically strong
words.example: The company offers wellness programs to improve employee fitness and productivity.
words.chinese: 健康狀況；體能；適能

words.engDef: made to happen or made to do something against your will
words.example: The company was forced to lay off employees due to the economic downturn.
words.chinese: 強迫的；被迫的；強制性的

words.engDef: a person who works for different companies on separate jobs
words.example: Our company often hires freelancers for short-term projects like graphic design and web development.
words.chinese: 自由接案者；獨立承包商，通常以專案為單位提供服務。

words.engDef: people who work for different companies on separate jobs
words.example: Our company is increasingly relying on freelancers for specialized projects.
words.chinese: 自由工作者；自由接案者（通常指獨立承接專案，而非全職員工）

words.engDef: the outer edge of something; also extra benefits beyond pay
words.example: The company offers competitive salaries and attractive fringe benefits, such as health insurance and a pension plan.
words.chinese: 邊緣；界線；附帶福利（尤指工資以外的）；瀏海；穗子；（尤指社會、政治等）邊緣的；非主流的；作為…的邊緣；給…加穗飾

words.engDef: an extra benefit supplementing salary, such as health insurance or a company car
words.example: Our company offers excellent fringe benefits, including dental care and a free gym membership.
words.chinese: 福利，額外津貼

words.engDef: a job with the normal full number of working hours
words.example: Many graduates aspire to secure a full time work position after completing their studies.
words.chinese: 全職工作，指每周工作 40 小時以上，通常享有相關福利的正式工作。

words.engDef: the people of a country as a whole
words.example: The survey results indicate a positive trend among the general population.
words.chinese: 一般大眾；普羅大眾（指不包含特定群體或樣本的整體人口）

words.engDef: to be given a higher position at work
words.example: After years of hard work, she finally got a promotion to Senior Manager.
words.chinese: 升遷；獲得晉升

words.engDef: to receive money for work done
words.example: Employees get paid bi-weekly based on their hours worked.
words.chinese: 獲得薪資；得到報酬

words.engDef: to increase someone's pay
words.example: The company decided to give a raise to employees who exceeded their performance goals.
words.chinese: 給予加薪；提高薪資

words.engDef: a party held for someone who is leaving
words.example: The company is organizing a going away party for Mr. Lee, who is retiring after 20 years of service.
words.chinese: 歡送會；離職歡送派對（通常為同事或朋友為即將離開的人舉辦的派對）

words.engDef: completed a degree course
words.example: She graduated from Harvard University with a degree in Business Administration.
words.chinese: 畢業；取得學位

words.engDef: people who have completed a degree course
words.example: Our company actively recruits graduates from top universities.
words.chinese: 畢業生；取得學位的學生

words.engDef: officially given or allowed
words.example: The company granted her a leave of absence to care for her sick mother.
words.chinese: （許可、同意）授予；給予；允許

words.engDef: increased in size; also fully developed
words.example: The company is looking for experienced professionals who have grown within the organization.
words.chinese: 長大；成長；（人或事物）成熟

words.engDef: the capacity to develop and become larger or better
words.example: The company is looking for candidates with high growth potential to fill the management trainee program.
words.chinese: 潛在增長力；成長潛力，指某人或某事物未來可能達到的成長或發展空間。

words.engDef: to trouble someone repeatedly in an unpleasant way
words.example: The company has a strict policy against harassing employees.
words.chinese: 騷擾；施加不必要的壓力或困擾（通常指在工作場所或權力關係中）

words.engDef: to receive medicine through a needle
words.example: All employees are required to have an injection against the flu during the annual health check.
words.chinese: 接受注射；接種疫苗或藥物

words.engDef: a recruiter who identifies and approaches suitable candidates for senior positions
words.example: A professional headhunter contacted him regarding a director position at a competitor firm.
words.chinese: 獵頭，高階人才獵聘者

words.engDef: the process of becoming healthy again
words.example: The company offers wellness programs to promote employee healing and reduce stress.
words.chinese: 療癒；康復（指身體或心理狀態的恢復）

words.engDef: an illness affecting the heart
words.example: The company offers comprehensive health insurance to cover potential heart ailments and other medical expenses.
words.chinese: 心臟疾病，指影響心臟功能的各種疾病。

words.engDef: a sudden dangerous failure of blood supply to the heart
words.example: The company offers comprehensive health insurance to cover potential heart attacks and other serious illnesses.
words.chinese: 心臟病突發，指心臟肌肉因血液供應不足而受損的緊急醫療狀況。

words.engDef: any illness that affects the heart
words.example: The company offers comprehensive health insurance to cover potential heart disease treatments.
words.chinese: 心血管疾病，泛指影響心臟和血管的各種疾病，可能導致健康問題和醫療費用增加。

words.engDef: a person who assists someone with their work
words.example: We are looking for a helper to assist our sales team with administrative tasks.
words.chinese: 協助者；幫手，通常指在特定任務或工作中提供支持的人。

words.engDef: employed someone to do a job
words.example: The company hired three new marketing specialists to boost sales.

words.engDef: employs people to do jobs
words.example: The company plans to hire five new sales representatives this quarter.
words.chinese: 雇用；聘用

words.engDef: the process of taking on new staff
words.example: The company is hiring three new sales representatives to expand its market coverage.
words.chinese: 招聘；雇用（指公司或組織尋找並聘請新員工的行為）

words.engDef: the group that decides which candidate to employ
words.example: The hiring committee will review all applications next week.
words.chinese: 招聘委員會；負責招聘和選拔候選人的委員會。

words.engDef: a payment given for professional services rendered nominally without charge
words.example: The guest speaker received an honorarium of five hundred dollars for her lecture.
words.chinese: 講師費，車馬費

words.engDef: the department that deals with employing and supporting staff
words.example: The human resources department will conduct the new employee orientation next Monday.
words.chinese: 人力資源：企業或組織中負責招聘、培訓、薪酬、績效管理及勞資關係等事務的部門或相關管理領域。

words.engDef: people, as distinct from animals or machines
words.example: The company is investing in training programs to improve the skills of its humans.
words.chinese: 人類；（指）員工（通常指公司內的人力資源）

words.engDef: a condition of being physically or mentally unwell
words.example: The company offers sick leave to employees experiencing an illness.
words.chinese: 疾病；健康狀況不佳

words.engDef: to put deep into liquid; also to give all your attention to
words.example: To fully understand the market, new employees are required to immerse themselves in industry reports and competitor analysis.
words.chinese: 完全投入；深深吸收（知識、經驗等）

words.engDef: a person who comes to live permanently in another country
words.example: The company is actively recruiting skilled immigrants to fill critical roles.
words.chinese: 移民；移居者（通常指為了工作或生活而移居到其他國家的人）

words.engDef: people who come to live permanently in another country
words.example: The company is actively recruiting immigrants with specialized skills in engineering.
words.chinese: 移民；移居者（通常指移居到其他國家以尋求更好的生活或工作機會的人）

words.engDef: wanted by many employers or customers
words.example: Software engineers are highly in demand in the current job market.
words.chinese: 需求量大，供不應求

words.engDef: the fact of not being able to do something
words.example: Due to his inability to manage the project effectively, Mr. Lee was reassigned to a different role.
words.chinese: 缺乏能力；無能為力

words.engDef: the practice of making sure everyone is involved
words.example: The company is committed to fostering a culture of diversity and inclusion.
words.chinese: 包含；納入；包容性

words.engDef: not skilled enough to do a job properly

words.chinese: 缺乏能力、無能，指在特定領域或職位上不勝任。

words.engDef: the person currently holding a position

words.chinese: 現任者；現職人員（通常指在某職位上的人）

words.engDef: relating to India or its people

words.chinese: 源自印度或與印度相關的；印度人（複數）。在商務情境中，通常指來自印度的員工或客戶。

words.engDef: single people considered separately from a group

words.chinese: 個體；個人（通常指一群人中獨立存在的單位）

words.engDef: the process or action of introducing someone to a new job or office

words.chinese: 入職培訓，引導

words.engDef: having little knowledge or practice of something
words.example: The company offers a training program for inexperienced employees to improve their skills.
words.chinese: 缺乏經驗的；未經訓練的

words.engDef: having a disease caused by germs
words.example: The company temporarily closed the office after several employees were infected with the flu.
words.chinese: 感染；受污染（尤指疾病或有害物質）

words.engDef: an illness that can be passed from person to person

words.chinese: 傳染病，指透過接觸、空氣或其他途徑傳播的疾病，可能影響員工健康與公司營運。

words.engDef: a common illness with fever and aching, caused by a virus

words.chinese: 流行性感冒；流感（一種由病毒引起的傳染病）

words.engDef: medicines put into the body through a needle
words.example: The company provides annual flu injections for all employees to ensure a healthy workforce.
words.chinese: 注射；（醫療）接種

words.engDef: to cause physical harm to someone
words.example: The employee injured his back while lifting heavy boxes during the inventory process.
words.chinese: 造成傷害；受傷

words.engDef: physically harmed
words.example: The employee was injured in a workplace accident and is currently on medical leave.
words.chinese: 受傷的；因傷而導致身體受損的

words.engDef: physical harm done to bodies

words.chinese: 傷害、損傷（尤指身體上的）；損害

words.engDef: physical harm done to a person's body
words.example: The company is providing compensation for the employee's work-related injury.
words.chinese: 傷害、損傷，尤指身體上的受傷，或因事故、意外造成的損失。

words.engDef: present from birth rather than learned
words.example: The company values employees with an innate ability to lead and motivate others.
words.chinese: 與生俱來；天生的；內在的

words.engDef: not confident; also not safely fixed or protected

words.chinese: 缺乏安全感；不自信，易受影響

words.engDef: the condition of being unable to sleep
words.example: The employee's insomnia has significantly impacted his productivity and attendance.
words.chinese: 失眠症；無法入睡或維持睡眠的狀態，影響工作效率和健康。

words.engDef: to fill someone with the wish or ability to do something
words.example: The CEO's vision inspired the entire team to work harder and achieve their goals.
words.chinese: 激發（靈感、動力、熱情等），鼓舞

words.engDef: filling people with confidence and the wish to act
words.example: The CEO's inspiring speech motivated the entire team to work harder.
words.chinese: 鼓舞人心的；激勵士氣的，使人充滿熱情和動力。

words.engDef: a person who teaches a practical skill
words.example: The company is looking for experienced instructors to train new employees.
words.chinese: 指導者；教練（通常指專業領域的指導者，例如飛行教練、駕駛教練等）

words.engDef: people who teach practical skills
words.example: The company hired several instructors to train new employees on the software.
words.chinese: 指導者；教練（通常指在專業或技能培訓領域的指導者）

words.engDef: the ability to learn, understand, and think clearly
words.example: The company values employees with high emotional intelligence and strong problem-solving skills.
words.chinese: 智力、聰明才智，尤其指解決問題和學習的能力。

words.engDef: a student or trainee working to gain experience
words.example: The company offers internships to recent graduates to help them gain practical experience.
words.chinese: 實習生；短期實習者，通常是大學或學院學生，在公司或機構從事短期工作以獲取工作經驗。

words.engDef: a period of work done to gain experience in a job
words.example: Many students seek internships to gain practical experience in their chosen field.
words.chinese: 實習，為期有限的時間，通常在公司或機構中，以獲取工作經驗。

words.engDef: asked someone questions in a formal meeting
words.example: The candidate was interviewed by the hiring manager last week.
words.chinese: 面試；被面試

words.engDef: the person being asked the questions in an interview
words.example: The HR manager scheduled interviews with several qualified interviewees.
words.chinese: 面試者；受訪者（指接受面試或採訪的人）

words.engDef: the person who asks the questions in an interview
words.example: The interviewer asked several questions about my previous work experience.
words.chinese: 面試官；面試者

words.engDef: the people who ask the questions in interviews
words.example: The HR department is scheduling interviews with potential candidates next week.
words.chinese: 面試官；面試者（複數）

words.engDef: asking someone questions in a formal meeting
words.example: The HR department is currently interviewing candidates for the marketing manager position.
words.chinese: 面試；面談（通常指工作或職位相關）

words.engDef: formal meetings in which someone is asked questions
words.example: The HR department is scheduling interviews for next week.
words.chinese: 面試；面談（通常指正式的求職面試或商務面談）

words.engDef: not showing proper care for the results of your actions
words.example: The employee's irresponsible handling of the project led to significant financial losses.
words.chinese: 不負責任的；玩忽職責的，缺乏責任感

words.engDef: a reduction in the number of jobs at a company
words.example: The company announced a job cutback due to the recent economic downturn.
words.chinese: 裁員削減，公司因經濟或營運考量而減少員工數量。

words.engDef: an event where employers meet people looking for work
words.example: Our company will be participating in the annual job fair next month to recruit fresh graduates.
words.chinese: 就業博覽會；徵才博覽會，通常由公司聚集在一起，為求職者提供面試和就業機會。

words.engDef: a formal proposal to employ someone
words.example: The company extended a job offer to Ms. Lee, pending a successful background check.
words.chinese: 工作邀約；公司正式發出的聘僱邀請，包含職位、薪資、福利等條件。

words.engDef: a chance to get a particular job
words.example: The company website lists several job opportunities for recent graduates.
words.chinese: 職位空缺；工作機會

words.engDef: the pleasure you get from doing your work
words.example: The company is implementing new policies to improve employee job satisfaction.
words.chinese: 工作滿意度，指員工對其工作、工作環境及雇主所感到的整體滿意程度。

words.engDef: the process of looking for work
words.example: The company offers career counseling to assist employees with their job search.
words.chinese: 求職活動；職位搜尋

words.engDef: a person who is looking for work
words.example: The company is hosting a career fair to attract job seekers.
words.chinese: 求職者；正在尋找工作的候選人

words.engDef: the official name of someone's position
words.example: The HR department is responsible for updating employee job titles in the company database.
words.chinese: 職位名稱；工作頭銜

words.engDef: the paid positions people work in
words.example: The company is currently hiring for several entry-level jobs in the marketing department.
words.chinese: 工作；職位；任務

words.engDef: formed an opinion about the value or quality of something
words.example: The candidate's performance was judged to be excellent based on the interview and skills assessment.
words.chinese: 評估；評判；認定（價值、能力或品質）

words.engDef: people who decide the winner or give a legal decision
words.example: The panel of judges will evaluate the presentations based on clarity and innovation.
words.chinese: 法官；評判者；評審者

words.engDef: in a fair and deserved way
words.example: The company decided to justly compensate the employee for the overtime work.
words.chinese: 公平地；正當地（尤指根據法律或道德標準）

words.engDef: children
words.example: The company offers childcare benefits to attract and retain employees with young kids.
words.chinese: 兒童；小孩（通常指一群孩子）

words.engDef: the money a company spends on paying its workers
words.example: The company is looking for ways to reduce labor costs without affecting employee morale.
words.chinese: 勞動成本，指企業為支付員工工資、福利、社會保險等所產生的費用。

words.engDef: a disagreement between workers and their employer
words.example: The company is currently negotiating with the union to resolve the ongoing labor dispute.
words.chinese: 勞資爭議；勞工與雇主之間的衝突或不和諧關係，通常涉及工資、工作條件或權益等問題。

words.engDef: to not feel sure of your own ability
words.example: Many junior employees lack confidence when presenting ideas in meetings.
words.chinese: 缺乏自信，對自身能力或判斷力感到不確定。

words.engDef: the process by which people learn a language
words.example: The company offers language acquisition programs to help employees improve their communication skills.
words.chinese: 語言習得：指學習和掌握一門語言的過程，包括詞彙、語法和語用能力的獲取。

words.engDef: to end someone's employment because there is not enough work
words.example: Due to the economic downturn, the company had to lay off 10% of its workforce.
words.chinese: 裁員；解雇（通常指因公司經濟狀況或重組而解僱員工）

words.engDef: a temporary or permanent discharge of workers due to economic conditions
words.example: The factory announced the layoff of two hundred temporary assembly line workers.
words.chinese: 臨時解雇，裁員

words.engDef: dismissals of workers because there is not enough work
words.example: Due to the economic downturn, the company announced layoffs affecting several departments.
words.chinese: 裁員；大規模解雇（通常指公司因經濟原因而解僱員工）

words.engDef: people who guide and direct others
words.example: The company is seeking strong leaders to drive innovation and growth.
words.chinese: 領導者；領導人物

words.engDef: a place providing courses and study resources
words.example: The company partners with a local learning center to provide employees with language training.
words.chinese: 學習中心，通常提供各種課程、研討會和資源，幫助學習者提升技能或準備考試。

words.engDef: to release something; also to dismiss an employee
words.example: Due to restructuring, the company had to let go of several employees.
words.chinese: 釋放；放手；解僱；放棄（權利、控制等）

words.engDef: a letter praising someone's abilities for a job or course
words.example: The HR department requires a letter of recommendation from your previous employer.
words.chinese: 推薦信，通常用於求職或升學，由了解申請人能力和資歷的人士撰寫。

words.engDef: the number of years a person is expected to live
words.example: The company is investing in wellness programs to improve employee life expectancy and reduce healthcare costs.
words.chinese: 預期壽命；平均壽命，通常指某個群體或地區的平均生存年數。

words.engDef: a system in which staff keep their jobs for their whole career
words.example: The company's policy of lifetime employment has contributed to high employee loyalty.
words.chinese: 終身僱用；指雇主與員工之間訂立的協議，承諾員工在職涯中終身受僱。

words.engDef: to take care of someone or something
words.example: The company provides childcare services to help employees look after their children.
words.chinese: 照顧；負責照看（人或事物），確保其安全或良好狀態。

words.engDef: to admire and respect someone
words.example: Many young employees look up to their senior colleagues for guidance and mentorship.
words.chinese: 敬佩、仰慕（某人），視...為榜樣

words.engDef: to promise firmly to do something
words.example: The company has made a commitment to reduce its carbon footprint by 20% by next year.
words.chinese: 承諾並採取行動以實現某目標，表示對某事或某人的堅定承諾。

words.engDef: to judge the quality or value of something
words.example: The manager needs to make an assessment of each employee's performance before the annual review.
words.chinese: 評估；評估情況

words.engDef: the people who run a company; also the act of running it
words.example: Effective management is crucial for a company's success.
words.chinese: 管理；経営；主管

words.engDef: a training session for managers
words.example: The company is offering a management seminar to help supervisors improve their leadership skills.
words.chinese: 管理研討會；針對管理人員提升技能的課程或工作坊。

words.engDef: the people responsible for running part of a company
words.example: The managers are responsible for ensuring the project stays within budget and meets deadlines.
words.chinese: 管理者；經理人，通常指負責領導和監督團隊或部門的人員。

words.engDef: required by law or rules
words.example: Attendance at the safety training is mandatory for all employees.
words.chinese: 強制性的；必修的

words.engDef: the act of controlling someone or something unfairly
words.example: The manager accused the employee of manipulation to secure a promotion.
words.chinese: 操縱；影響（他人或情況以達到特定目的）

words.engDef: the number of workers available for a job
words.example: We need to assess our manpower requirements for the upcoming project.
words.chinese: 勞動力；人力資源（指可用於工作的人員數量）

words.engDef: people highly skilled at something; also a higher degree
words.example: The company seeks candidates with a Master's degree in Business Administration.
words.chinese: 碩士學位；精通者

words.engDef: a university qualification taken after a first degree
words.example: Many companies prefer candidates with a master's degree in business administration.
words.chinese: 碩士學位，通常指在大學本科畢業後，進修兩年以上所獲得的高等學歷。

words.engDef: relating to the period around the birth of a child
words.example: The company offers generous maternity leave benefits to its female employees.
words.chinese: 產假；與生育相關的福利或政策

words.engDef: time off work given to a mother around the birth of her child
words.example: The company offers a generous maternity leave policy to support new mothers.
words.chinese: 產假；女性員工因生育而獲得的休假。

words.engDef: the state of being married
words.example: The company's policy regarding employee benefits extends to legal matrimony.
words.chinese: 婚姻；結合

words.engDef: the people who belong to a group or organisation
words.example: All members are entitled to a 10% discount on our products.
words.chinese: 會員；成員（指組織、社團等的成員）

words.engDef: an informal word for mothers
words.example: The company is launching a new initiative to support working moms and improve work-life balance.
words.chinese: 母親們；（指）母親群體

words.engDef: having a strong reason to work hard
words.example: The company offers performance-based bonuses to keep employees motivated.
words.chinese: 有動機的；驅使的；積極主動的

words.engDef: intended to make people want to work harder
words.example: The manager delivered a motivational speech to boost employee morale before the project launch.
words.chinese: 鼓舞人心的；激勵士氣的，旨在提升動機和熱情。

words.engDef: to rise to a higher position or level
words.example: After years of hard work, she moved up to a management position.
words.chinese: 晉升；升遷；（地位、排名等）提升

words.engDef: the parts of the body that tighten to produce movement
words.example: The company offers wellness programs to help employees strengthen their muscles and improve overall health.
words.chinese: 肌肉；（尤指）體能、力量

words.engDef: a person who has recently arrived or joined
words.example: The company is offering a comprehensive onboarding program for all newcomers.
words.chinese: 新進員工/成員；新來者

words.engDef: having come to a place only a short time ago
words.example: The newly arrived employee is undergoing an orientation program.
words.chinese: 新到職的；剛抵達的（通常指員工或訪客）

words.engDef: the work of caring for sick people
words.example: The company offers comprehensive nursing care benefits to its employees.
words.chinese: 護理（工作）；照護；看護

words.engDef: the condition of being very much overweight
words.example: The company is implementing wellness programs to address employee obesity and promote a healthier work environment.
words.chinese: 過度肥胖；肥胖症（指體重過重，且脂肪過多，對健康造成負面影響的狀態）

words.engDef: the keeping of a rule, law, or custom
words.example: The company emphasizes the observance of all safety regulations to ensure a secure working environment.
words.chinese: 遵守；遵循（規定、傳統等）

words.engDef: clearly having the training and skills needed
words.example: The candidate is obviously qualified for the position based on her extensive experience and education.
words.chinese: 顯然勝任的；無庸置疑具備資歷的

words.engDef: the field concerned with keeping workers safe and healthy
words.example: The company is committed to maintaining high standards of occupational safety and health for all employees.
words.chinese: 職業安全與健康，指保障員工在工作場所免受危害，並促進安全健康工作環境的規範與措施。

words.engDef: the formal name of a person's position
words.example: Please state your official title when contacting our company.
words.chinese: 正式職稱；官方頭銜

words.engDef: training given while actually doing the work
words.example: New employees will undergo OJT for the first three months to familiarize themselves with the company's procedures.
words.chinese: 在職訓練，指在實際工作環境中進行的訓練，讓員工透過實務操作學習。

words.engDef: available to work if you are needed
words.example: Our IT staff are on call 24/7 to handle urgent system issues.
words.chinese: 待命狀態，隨時準備應變；在待命狀態下可被徵召。

words.engDef: being watched for a period to see if your work is acceptable
words.example: The employee was placed on probation after repeated tardiness.
words.chinese: 假釋；試用期（通常指員工或員工在犯錯後，在監督下繼續工作）

words.engDef: refusing to work as a protest over pay or conditions
words.example: The factory workers went on strike demanding higher wages and better working conditions.
words.chinese: 罷工；因勞資糾紛停止工作

words.engDef: recorded to be offered a place if one becomes free
words.example: Due to high demand, applicants are placed on the waiting list if a position is not immediately available.
words.chinese: 候選名單；等待名單（通常指尚未正式錄用，但仍保留機會的候選人或項目）

words.engDef: the provision of assistance to laid-off employees in finding new jobs
words.example: As part of the severance package, the firm provided outplacement services to the staff.
words.chinese: （為被裁員工提供的）轉職就業協助

words.engDef: to take too much of a drug at one time
words.example: The company is implementing stricter safety protocols to prevent employees from overdosing on medication.
words.chinese: 過量服用；過度使用（藥物、物質等），導致不良後果。

words.engDef: having more skills or qualifications than a job needs
words.example: Although she has extensive experience, she was told she was overqualified for the entry-level position.
words.chinese: 能力過於勝任；資格過高，不符合職位需求

words.engDef: having more workers than are needed
words.example: The company is currently overstaffed due to the recent hiring spree.
words.chinese: 人員編制過多，員工數量超出實際需求。

words.engDef: time worked beyond your normal hours
words.example: The company offers overtime pay for employees who work beyond their regular hours.
words.chinese: 加班；額外工作時間（通常指超出正常工作時間的工時，並可能獲得額外報酬）

words.engDef: extra money paid for working beyond normal hours
words.example: The company policy states that employees are entitled to overtime allowance for any work exceeding 40 hours per week.
words.chinese: 加班費；額外支付給員工因加班而獲得的報酬。

words.engDef: the hours worked beyond the normal working time
words.example: The company policy states that overtime hours must be approved by the supervisor.
words.chinese: 加班時數，指員工在正常工作時間以外所做的工時，通常需要額外支付加班費。

words.engDef: the rate of pay for hours worked beyond normal hours
words.example: The company's overtime rate is 1.5 times the regular hourly wage.
words.chinese: 加班費率；超過正常工作時間的薪資計算方式。

words.engDef: heavier than is healthy
words.example: The company offers wellness programs to help employees maintain a healthy weight and avoid becoming overweight.
words.chinese: 過重；體重超標（通常指超出健康範圍）

words.engDef: time away from work for which you are still paid
words.example: The company offers generous paid leave benefits to attract and retain talented employees.
words.chinese: 因故請假期間所領取的薪資，通常指病假、產假、育嬰假等。

words.engDef: holiday time for which an employee still receives wages
words.example: Our company offers employees two weeks of paid vacation per year.
words.chinese: 公司或組織給予員工的帶薪休假，通常用於度假或個人事務。

words.engDef: the state of being a father
words.example: The company's new paternity initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.
words.chinese: 陪產假

words.engDef: people receiving medical treatment
words.example: The company is committed to providing a supportive work environment for employees and understanding the needs of patients who may be dealing with personal challenges.
words.chinese: 病人；容忍、忍耐（尤指對不愉快的事物）

words.engDef: a rise in the amount someone is paid
words.example: The company announced a 3% pay increase for all employees effective next month.
words.chinese: 薪資增額；加薪

words.engDef: an increase in someone's wages
words.example: After a year of excellent performance, the employee received a significant pay raise.
words.chinese: 薪資調整；加薪

words.engDef: a list of employees and the amount of money they are paid
words.example: The accounting office is responsible for processing the monthly payroll.
words.chinese: 員工薪資名冊，薪資總額

words.engDef: people of the same age or position as you
words.example: The company encourages employees to learn from their peers through mentorship programs.
words.chinese: 同儕；與自己同齡或地位相當的人

words.engDef: to punish someone for breaking a rule
words.example: We need to penalize this carefully.
words.chinese: 懲罰

words.engDef: an amount paid to help support someone in retirement
words.example: The company is reviewing its pension allowance scheme to ensure compliance with new regulations.
words.chinese: 退休金津貼；退休金補助（通常指政府或公司為員工提供的額外退休金福利）

words.engDef: casual term for fringe benefits or special privileges
words.example: Free snacks and flexible working hours are some of the perks of working at a tech startup.
words.chinese: 額外福利，特權

words.engDef: the work of organising and looking after a company's staff
words.example: Effective personnel management is crucial for maintaining employee morale and productivity.
words.chinese: 人員管理：指規劃、組織、引導和控制組織內人員的活動，以實現組織目標的過程。

words.engDef: a check of the body carried out by a doctor
words.example: All employees are required to undergo a physical examination annually for health and safety reasons.
words.chinese: 身體檢查，通常指由醫生或醫療專業人員進行的全面身體評估。

words.engDef: treatment of injuries by exercise and massage
words.example: The company offers comprehensive health benefits, including coverage for physical therapy.
words.chinese: 物理治療；復健治療，指透過運動、按摩等方式，幫助患者恢復身體功能。

words.engDef: the official rules and plans of an organisation
words.example: The company's policies regarding remote work are clearly outlined in the employee handbook.
words.chinese: 政策；規定（公司或組織的正式規定）

words.engDef: receiving low wages
words.example: Many entry-level positions are poorly paid, but offer valuable experience.
words.chinese: 薪資微薄的；薪水低的

words.engDef: jobs or posts within an organisation
words.example: The company is currently seeking to fill several management positions.
words.chinese: 職位；崗位；位置（指工作或組織中的）

words.engDef: the act of publishing a notice or job advertisement
words.example: The HR department is posting a new vacancy for a sales manager on the company website.
words.chinese: 張貼、發布（如職缺、公告或訊息）；在會計或系統中登錄（如費用、交易）

words.engDef: knowledge gained by actually doing the work
words.example: The company values candidates with practical experience in project management.
words.chinese: 實際經驗；實務經驗，指透過實際工作或活動所獲得的經驗。

words.engDef: expressed strong approval of someone or something
words.example: The manager praised her team's dedication to completing the project ahead of schedule.
words.chinese: 讚揚；稱讚；表揚

words.engDef: better treatment given to one person than to others
words.example: The company is committed to eliminating preferential treatment and ensuring equal opportunities for all employees.
words.chinese: 優先待遇；特權，因某種原因給予某人或某事比其他人或事物更優惠的待遇。

words.engDef: something that must exist before something else can happen
words.example: Completing this online course is a prerequisite for attending the advanced training program.
words.chinese: 必要條件；先決條件（指完成某事或達到某目標所必須滿足的條件或要求）

words.engDef: the act of stopping something bad from happening
words.example: The company implemented several safety preventions to reduce workplace accidents.
words.chinese: 預防措施；防止（某事發生）

words.engDef: the position someone held before the current one
words.example: During the interview, be prepared to discuss your previous job responsibilities and accomplishments.
words.chinese: 先前的工作經歷；過去的職位

words.engDef: a special right given to one person or group
words.example: Senior employees often enjoy certain privileges, such as flexible working hours and company car.
words.chinese: 特權；享有…的權利或優待（通常指因身份、地位或財富而獲得的）。

words.engDef: a process of testing the ability, character, or suitability of a worker
words.example: New employees must complete a three-month probation period before receiving benefits.
words.chinese: 試用期，緩刑

words.engDef: relating to a period of probation or testing of an employee
words.example: During the probationary period, her work will be closely monitored by her supervisor.
words.chinese: 試用期的

words.engDef: a new employee still being tested in the job
words.example: All new hires begin their employment as probationers for a period of six months.
words.chinese: 試用期員工；受訓人員

words.engDef: a job that needs special training and qualifications
words.example: She chose a profession in healthcare because she wanted to help others.
words.chinese: 職業；事業（通常指需要專業知識或技能的活動）

words.engDef: people who do a job requiring special training
words.example: The company is seeking experienced professionals to fill the open positions in the IT department.
words.chinese: 專業人士；專業從業人員

words.engDef: jobs that need special training and qualifications
words.example: The company offers training programs to help employees advance in their professions.
words.chinese: 職業；事業

words.engDef: given a higher position at work; also advertised
words.example: After three years of outstanding performance, she was promoted to senior manager.
words.chinese: 提升（職位或等級）；推廣（產品、服務或訊息）

words.engDef: a move to a higher position; also advertising activity
words.example: She received a promotion to Senior Manager after exceeding her sales targets.
words.chinese: 晉升；提升（職位）；促銷活動

words.engDef: a document showing that someone works for a company
words.example: The bank requires proof of employment and a recent pay stub for the loan application.
words.chinese: 在職證明，用以確認員工目前在公司就職的正式文件。

words.engDef: relating to the mind and how it works
words.example: The employee's performance issues may be due to psychological factors, requiring a sensitive approach.
words.chinese: 與心理學相關的；涉及心理過程或心理狀態的。

words.engDef: the study of the mind and behaviour
words.example: The HR department is considering incorporating psychological assessments into the hiring process.
words.chinese: 心理學；心理學研究

words.engDef: to make someone suffer for breaking a rule
words.example: The company will punish employees who violate the code of conduct.
words.chinese: 懲罰；處罰；施以懲戒

words.engDef: something unpleasant done to someone for breaking a rule
words.example: The company has a strict policy regarding punishment for employees who violate company regulations.
words.chinese: 懲罰；處罰；制裁

words.engDef: to follow or work towards something over time
words.example: The company encourages employees to pursue professional development opportunities.
words.chinese: 追求；積極追尋（目標、事業、夢想等）

words.engDef: following or working towards something over time
words.example: The company is pursuing a new market segment to increase its revenue.
words.chinese: 積極追求；致力於（某目標或事業）

words.engDef: the exams passed and training completed for a job
words.example: The job description lists the required qualifications, including a bachelor's degree and five years of experience.
words.chinese: 資歷；資格；學歷與經驗證明

words.engDef: having the training or exams needed for a job
words.example: The candidate is highly qualified for the position, possessing extensive experience in project management.
words.chinese: 具備資格的；符合要求的；勝任的

words.engDef: leaving a job or stopping an activity
words.example: He decided to quit his job to pursue his dream of starting a business.
words.chinese: 辭職；停止從事

words.engDef: relating to people's race or origin
words.example: The company is committed to promoting racial equality in the workplace.
words.chinese: 種族的；人種的

words.engDef: increasing an amount; also bringing up children
words.example: The company is raising salaries by 5% to retain top talent.
words.chinese: 提升、提高（價格、薪資、標準等）；培養、撫養（子女）

words.engDef: a position in a scale of importance or quality
words.example: The company uses a performance-based ranking system to determine salary increases.
words.chinese: 等級；排名；職等

words.engDef: to develop as far as your abilities allow
words.example: The company provides training programs to help employees reach their full potential.
words.chinese: 充分發揮潛能；達到最佳績效

words.engDef: to make a request again after being refused or after time passes
words.example: Due to the company's restructuring, many employees had to reapply for their current positions.
words.chinese: 重新申請；再次提交（申請、文件等）

words.engDef: to give someone a different job or duty
words.example: Due to the restructuring, several employees will be reassigned to different departments.
words.chinese: 重新指派；重新分配（職務、資源等）

words.engDef: a letter praising someone's ability for a job or course
words.example: The HR department requires a recommendation letter from your previous employer.
words.chinese: 推薦信，通常由前任雇主、教授或同事撰寫，用以證明求職者的能力、經驗和品格。

words.engDef: a person whose job is to enlist or hire new employees
words.example: The corporate recruiter screened hundreds of resumes for the marketing vacancy.
words.chinese: 招募人員，招聘專員

words.engDef: looking for and taking on new staff or members
words.example: The company is currently recruiting for several marketing positions.
words.chinese: 招聘；招募（人才）

words.engDef: the process of finding and employing new staff
words.example: The company's new recruitment initiative exceeded expectations in the first quarter.
words.chinese: 招聘

words.engDef: to get better after illness or hard work
words.example: After a demanding project, employees are encouraged to recuperate and recharge.
words.chinese: 恢復體力或健康；休養

words.engDef: a letter from someone who knows your work, supporting your application
words.example: The HR department requires a reference letter from your previous employer.
words.chinese: 推薦信；工作/學術推薦信，通常由前任主管或教授撰寫，用以證明申請人的能力與資歷。

words.engDef: people who can speak for your character or ability
words.example: The HR department requires three professional references for each job applicant.
words.chinese: 推薦信；參考文獻；（資料）參考

words.engDef: extra pay given because of where you work
words.example: The company offers a regional allowance to employees working in remote areas to compensate for the higher cost of living.
words.chinese: 地區津貼；因地區差異而提供的額外補助或津貼

words.engDef: to repay a person who has spent money on business expenses
words.example: The firm will reimburse you for all travel and lodging expenses.
words.chinese: 報銷，退還，補償

words.engDef: the action of repaying someone for spent business expenses
words.example: Please submit your receipts to the accounting office for reimbursement.
words.chinese: 報銷，退款

words.engDef: the strengthening of something; also encouragement to repeat behaviour
words.example: The company offers performance-based bonuses as a reinforcement for achieving sales targets.
words.chinese: 強化；增強（效力、行為等）

words.engDef: to put someone back in a job or position they had lost
words.example: After a thorough investigation, the company decided to reinstate the employee who was wrongly dismissed.
words.chinese: 恢復（某人或某事）到先前的位置或狀態；重新任命

words.engDef: members of your family
words.example: The company policy states that immediate relatives are not allowed to work in the same department.
words.chinese: 親屬；關係人（通常指家庭成員或有親屬關係的人）

words.engDef: to make pain less severe
words.example: The company offers wellness programs to relieve employee stress and improve productivity.
words.chinese: 減輕痛苦；緩解疼痛

words.engDef: to move to a new place to live or work
words.example: The company is relocating its headquarters to a larger facility in the city center.

words.engDef: moving to a new place to live or work

words.example: Due to the upcoming deadline, employees may be required to work additional hours.
words.chinese: 額外工作時數；加班

words.engDef: the record of the jobs someone has had
words.example: The HR department needs to review each candidate's work history to assess their qualifications.
words.chinese: 工作經歷，職務履歷

words.example: The company is implementing a new work shift system to improve productivity.
words.chinese: 工作排班；工作班次

words.engDef: people who do a job, especially manual or hourly work

words.chinese: 勞工；工作人員（通常指從事體力勞動或技術性工作的員工）

words.example: The company is committed to improving working conditions for all employees, including better safety measures and flexible hours.

words.engDef: practical training sessions where people learn by doing

words.chinese: 工作坊；研討會（通常為實用性較強的短期課程或活動）

words.example: The company seeks zealous candidates who are passionate about innovation and eager to contribute to our team.
words.chinese: 熱忱的；充滿熱情的，尤指對某事抱有強烈信念或渴望。
